what: Batches and the batch card (ADR-103, BL-18.5, BL-20.1 in part)
method: Built-in browser on the dev API and dev web server, a demonstration delivering organisation with three batches (a draft, a published one, a cancelled one); width 375-380 px (the pane's own size) and, for text fit, 360 px with the root font at 200% in Hindi. First-load bytes from `npm run build:e2e` + `route-bundle-stats.json`. Phone bundle from `make check-mobile-budget`.

at_200_percent_form_open_before_fix.cause: a grid form with no one-column base (`grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2`) has an implicit auto column as wide as its widest hint

first_load_bytes.note: every route grew by 32 B (the shared chunk) against Sprint 97; the batches page is its own route and costs no other route anything

phone_bundle_bytes.note: grew about 9,000 B from the three message catalogues (the phone carries the web's messages); no batch screen on the phone yet

tests.survivors: 1 equivalent (a lock-narrowing optimisation), six closed with tests
